name: dynamic-alert-map
description: Real-time dynamic alert visualization map using public alert feeds

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w packages/backend" "npm run dev -w packages/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run docker:up && sleep 8 && npm run migrate -w packages/backend && npm run seed -w packages/backend
